decision.reason: React-admin is the only tested full UI candidate that installed without peer overrides while supplying the admin, data, authentication, routing, form and access-control primitives required by later Eva dashboard slices.

criteria: maintained stable release and permissive license
custom adapter for Eva's existing API instead of a second backend
owner authentication without browser credential storage
no external browser requests or telemetry
read-only anonymous failure before identity or workboard data
future forms, access control and task-board support
eventual removal of Eva's duplicate presentation code

build.peerConflict: notistack 2.0.8 requires @mui/material ^5.0.0 while the current Refine MUI line installs @mui/material 6.5.0

refine.decision: not selected because the current supported UI stack is not peer-clean; smaller bundle size remains a documented advantage

appsmith.decision: not taken to a bundle trial because it is a separately deployed low-code platform and would add a second application/runtime rather than replace Eva's presentation layer with a frontend library

promotionGates: serve immutable built assets from the owner-protected Eva route with a strict CSP
validate every API response against Eva's versioned contracts
retain server-side person, consent and mutation authority
remove the old embedded cockpit presentation instead of running two dashboards
add targeted route, CSP, anonymous-access and browser tests
build and scan the complete candidate image
promote only through the managed A/B data-copy and rollback cycle
nonClaims: React-admin is not live in Eva2.
The current embedded cockpit has not yet been removed.
The candidate does not prove dashboard write actions, CSRF protection, mobile usability or a complete consumer installation.
Selection is not a permanent superiority claim; component-watch and Renovate must reopen it when the dependency line or competitors materially change.
